candidate_decisions.reason: The exact 5:92 and 5:99 surfaces connect the messenger and delivery terms with clear conveyance and an explicit possibility of turning away. The registered focus branches land directly, while root_000170/B005 is retained as attributed contextual evidence because its 5:92 word coordinate and return through the focus delivery term are supplied even though no independent branch record is available.

The 5:94 test supplies an exact in-pericope mechanism by which reachable conduct exposes a hidden response. All six nominated branches have either a registered focus carrier or an exact attributed 5:94 context coordinate that returns through the focus disclosure, knowledge, or concealment terms; the medium legacy trace is therefore retained as qualified evidence rather than suppressed.

The 5:95 offering is explicitly required to reach the Kaaba, giving the focus delivery noun a distinct endpoint relation. The two registered delivery branches and the unresolved destination branch are all landed through exact 5:95 coordinates and return through 5:99:5:2; the qualified trace adds a material arrival condition without claiming recipient acceptance.

The exact 5:101 surface supplies questioning, harmful disclosure, and revelatory timing around the focus messenger-duty statement. Each nominated branch lands through the focus or an exact 5:101 coordinate, and the result remains a bounded authorization reading with legacy HFT qualification rather than a claim that every concealed matter must be exposed.

The 5:106 testimony rule and 5:107 discovery-and-replacement procedure give concealment a socially consequential evidence carrier and a concrete disclosure repair. All five nominated branches land through the focus or exact testimony/discovery coordinates, with the unresolved testimony and discovery branches retained as attributed contextual evidence.

The outlier has an explicit form-distant focus split, exact testimony coordinates, and a stated exploratory information-allocation analogy. It is materially distinct from the withheld-testimony finding, so its qualified containment is preserved rather than represented away; the unresolved testimony branch remains attributed.

findings.title: Clear delivery without coercion
findings.claim: The surrounding messenger formula gives the focus's bounded duty a clear-delivery condition: the message is to be made intelligible, while the audience's turning away remains a separate response.
findings.mechanism: The focus terms for messenger and delivery contact the repeated 5:92 formula, where clear conveyance appears beside an explicit conditional of turning away. That contact makes clarity a property of the entrusted delivery and keeps obedience outside the messenger's office.
findings.reader_payoff: The word for the messenger's duty opens onto a precise limit: responsibility includes intelligible conveyance, while successful compliance is not folded into the duty itself.
findings.containment: This is a qualified pericope reading of the messenger's office. It preserves the plain duty of conveying and does not claim that clarity guarantees acceptance or that every messenger statement has the same legal scope.

epistemic.reason: The Arabic anchors and registered focus branches are supplied, but the HFT segmentation and role assignment are legacy-unbound; the unresolved clarity branch is therefore attributed rather than lexically asserted.

findings.title: A hidden response becomes conduct
findings.claim: The nearby test sequence makes the focus's shown and concealed poles legible as conduct and the hidden disposition behind it: a reachable temptation can expose whether restraint or transgression gives the hidden response a visible form.
findings.mechanism: The focus's knowing, disclosure, and concealment terms contact 5:94's test, attainable object, divine knowing, and unseen fear. The test supplies a conversion point where an inward allegiance or fear becomes observable through action.
findings.reader_payoff: The paired verbs can be heard across more than speech and private thought: what is shown may be conduct elicited by a test, while what is concealed may be the allegiance or fear from which that conduct proceeds.
findings.containment: The 5:94 sequence supplies one concrete subtype of what may be shown or concealed. It does not turn every act into a test, make divine knowing an acquisition of new knowledge, or replace the focus's ordinary public-and-hidden contrast.

epistemic.reason: The context Arabic and all HFT coordinates are supplied, but the reader trace is legacy-unbound and its confidence is medium; the result is retained as a qualified contextual reading with the stated judicial alternative left live.

findings.title: Delivery reaches its endpoint
findings.claim: The focus's بلاغ can be heard as delivery with an endpoint: like the designated offering that reaches the Kaaba, entrusted communication is complete as a handoff that arrives, while acceptance belongs to the recipient.

findings.reader_payoff: بلاغ becomes more than words leaving the messenger: the image keeps the addressee in view and makes arrival part of the entrusted act.
findings.containment: The qualified material analogy does not claim verified comprehension, recipient acceptance, or that every use of the root means physical arrival. The focus remains the messenger's bounded delivery duty.

epistemic.reason: The 5:95 Arabic destination and registered focus branches are exact, while the HFT transfer from material arrival to communication is legacy-unbound and remains qualified.

findings.reader_payoff: The pair of shown and concealed things no longer implies that every hidden matter should be dragged into view; the messenger's task stays tied to what is entrusted for conveyance.
findings.containment: This preserves the ordinary claim that God knows both poles. It does not declare every concealment innocent, make the focus a blanket rule about questioning, or turn the HFT inference into a general theory of transparency.

epistemic.reason: The exact 5:101 Arabic provides harmful disclosure and revelatory timing, but the authorization transfer is an unbound HFT inference; it is retained with its narrow alternative visible.

findings.title: Concealment can withhold testimony
findings.claim: The focus's concealment term can reach socially consequential evidence: testimony may be known yet withheld from public judgment, while discovery and replacement witnesses expose and repair what the procedure could not see at first.
findings.mechanism: The focus disclosure/concealment pair and divine knowing contact 5:106's explicit prohibition on concealing testimony and 5:107's discovery of guilt followed by replacement testimony. The context supplies a public procedure without reducing divine knowledge to that procedure.
findings.reader_payoff: Gizlediğiniz is not confined to an inward secret; it can name the active withholding of evidence whose absence affects other people's judgment.
findings.containment: The testimony sequence is a concrete subtype of concealment, not an exhaustive definition of every hidden state. Human procedure repairs some omissions, while the focus still places complete knowing with God.

epistemic.reason: The testimony and discovery Arabic anchors are exact and the focus branches are supplied, but the cross-ayah semantic transfer is a legacy-unbound HFT nomination; the alternative broader reading remains contained.

findings.title: An exploratory information-allocation contrast
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the shown-and-concealed pair also pictures control over information: actors release material into shared judgment or retain it as exclusive possession.
findings.mechanism: The form-distant focus split mapped to root_000092/B008 supplies exclusive possession, while 5:106 supplies testimony owed to a public procedure and active withholding. Their contact turns the disclosure/concealment pair into an information-allocation analogy.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus contrast gains an institutional edge: showing and concealing can describe who lets evidence enter common judgment and who keeps it under private control.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory analogy built from the packet's explicitly supplied form-distant split. It sits beside the ordinary visible/concealed reading and does not replace it, define a whole-surah information theory, or convert the analogy into a lexical gloss for every use of تُبْدُونَ.

epistemic.reason: The exact testimony anchors and focus split are supplied, but the HFT record labels the transfer exploratory and its reader identity is legacy-unbound; the analogy is therefore explicitly contained and not promoted to ordinary lexical fact.

findings.title: The named knower is also the worshiped addressee
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa contact places the focus's named subject الله within an act of worship: the one named as knowing what is shown and concealed is also the one addressed by the worshippers' "we worship" statement.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence of the proper divine name carries the accepted worship-and-worshiped-being branch, while external 1:5:2 supplies the explicit worship verb. The contact adds a bounded role relation to the name without changing the focus's knowledge predicate.
findings.reader_payoff: The proper name in the knowledge clause is heard as more than an abstract subject: the added external ayah recalls the same named being as the one toward whom worship is directed.
findings.containment: This is a Phase 2 external overlay only. It does not turn يَعْلَمُ into worship, make 1:5 part of the native pericope, or claim that the other Fātiḥa ayat add a separate focus reading.

epistemic.reason: The focus proper-name occurrence, accepted branch, and external 1:5 worship coordinate are supplied exactly; the added relation is a bounded contextual inference rather than an HFT or ordinary gloss claim.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.

branch_activations.boundary: The external contact does not activate worship as the meaning of يَعْلَمُ or claim a whole-Fātiḥa overlay beyond 1:5.

friction_notes: All six assigned macro HFT records were reviewed.
